hi.body:
## क्या जारी हुआ है

National Testing Agency (NTA) ने UGC-NET December 2026 के लिए परीक्षा शहर की advance जानकारी वाली slip जारी कर दी है। यह slip 25 नवंबर 2026 से https://ugenet.nta.nic.in/ पर अपने login credentials से डाउनलोड की जा सकती है।

इस slip से candidate को पहले से पता चल जाता है कि उसका परीक्षा केंद्र किस शहर में पड़ेगा।

## यह admit card नहीं है

सूचना में साफ़ कहा गया है कि Examination City Intimation Slip admit card नहीं है। यह सिर्फ़ परीक्षा शहर की जानकारी देती है। असली admit card अलग से आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर जारी किया जाएगा।

इसलिए परीक्षा में जाने के लिए इस slip को admit card मानकर न चलें। admit card आने का इंतज़ार करें और उसे साथ लेकर ही परीक्षा केंद्र पर जाएँ।

## परीक्षा कब और कैसे होगी

NTA के अनुसार UGC-NET December 2026 परीक्षा Computer-Based Test (CBT) mode में देश भर के केंद्रों पर होगी। सूचना में परीक्षा की तारीख़ें 4 से 8 दिसंबर और 2 दिसंबर 2026 बताई गई हैं।

## किसे क्या करना है

जिन candidates ने इस परीक्षा के लिए आवेदन किया है, वे वेबसाइट पर login करके अपनी slip डाउनलोड कर लें और देख लें कि परीक्षा शहर कौन सा है। इससे यात्रा और ठहरने का इंतज़ाम पहले से सोचा जा सकता है।

अगर slip डाउनलोड करने में दिक्कत आए, तो NTA Helpdesk 0-40759000 पर संपर्क करें या ugcnet@nta.ac.in पर ईमेल करें।

## आगे की जानकारी कहाँ मिलेगी

NTA ने candidates से कहा है कि वे https://ugcnet.nta.nic.in/ पर नियमित रूप से देखते रहें, ताकि परीक्षा से जुड़े नए अपडेट और admit card की जानकारी समय पर मिलती रहे।

en.title: UGC-NET December 2026: exam city intimation slip out, download now
en.summary: NTA on 25 November 2026 released the advance Examination City Intimation Slip for UGC-NET December 2026. It is for candidates who applied for the exam and want to know in advance which city their exam centre will be in.
en.searchTitle: UGC-NET December 2026: city intimation slip out
en.searchDescription: Download your exam city slip from ugenet.nta.nic.in using your login from 25 November. It is not the admit card; the admit card will come separately.
en.meaning: If you have applied for UGC-NET December 2026, you can now see in advance which city your exam centre will be in, which helps you plan travel and stay. Remember, this slip is not the admit card, so wait for the actual admit card before going to the exam.
keyFacts: The exam city intimation slip can be downloaded from 25 November 2026.
Candidates must log in at ugenet.nta.nic.in to download it.
The slip is not the admit card; it only gives the exam city.
The admit card will be issued separately on the official website.
The exam will be held in Computer-Based Test (CBT) mode at centres across the country on 4 to 8 December and 2 December 2026.
For help, contact the NTA Helpdesk at 0-40759000 or email ugcnet@nta.ac.in.

faq.q: When can I download the UGC-NET December 2026 city intimation slip?
faq.a: From 25 November 2026. According to the NTA notice, candidates can download the slip from this date.

faq.q: Where do I download the city intimation slip?
faq.a: At https://ugenet.nta.nic.in/ using your login credentials. This is the official website where the slip is available.

faq.q: Is the city intimation slip the admit card?
faq.a: No. The notice clearly says the slip is not the admit card. It only tells you the city where your exam centre will be.

faq.q: When will the UGC-NET December 2026 admit card come?
faq.a: The notice does not give a date for the admit card. NTA has said the admit card will be issued separately on the official website.

faq.q: Whom do I contact if I cannot download the slip?
faq.a: Contact the NTA Helpdesk at 0-40759000 or email ugcnet@nta.ac.in.

en.body:
## What has been released

The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the advance Examination City Intimation Slip for UGC-NET December 2026. The slip can be downloaded from 25 November 2026 at https://ugenet.nta.nic.in/ using your login credentials.

The slip tells a candidate in advance which city their examination centre will be in.

## It is not the admit card

The notice clearly states that the Examination City Intimation Slip is not the admit card. It only provides information about the exam city. The actual admit card will be issued separately on the official website.

So do not treat this slip as your admit card for the exam. Wait for the admit card and carry it to the exam centre.

## When and how the exam will be held

According to NTA, UGC-NET December 2026 will be held in Computer-Based Test (CBT) mode at centres across the country. The notice lists the exam dates as 4 to 8 December and 2 December 2026.

## What candidates should do

Candidates who applied for the exam should log in to the website, download their slip and check which city their exam centre is in. This helps them plan travel and stay in advance.

If you face difficulty in downloading the slip, contact the NTA Helpdesk at 0-40759000 or email ugcnet@nta.ac.in.

## Where to get further updates

NTA has asked candidates to regularly visit https://ugcnet.nta.nic.in/ so that new exam updates and information about the admit card reach them on time.
